chunks: Wahb ibn Wahb narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, that ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام used to say:
The protected area around an ancient well is fifty cubits, unless it is toward a watering place or toward a road; then it is less than that, up to twenty-five cubits.

key_terms.حَرِيمُ: the protected or reserved boundary area
key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: a cubit, a unit of length

ai.seo_question: What is the protected boundary around an ancient well in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the harim of an old well, setting its default protected boundary at fifty cubits. If the well is close to a watering place or a road, that reserved area is reduced to twenty-five cubits in order to account for surrounding public use and access.
